title: Lifting a bounded free stalk complex without a derived comparison
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], x a point, R its stalk ring [def-pc-module-stalk-functor], d : Z -> N, and F a cochain complex of R-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Suppose F is zero outside some finite degree interval and F^i is isomorphic to R^(d i) for every i. There exist an affine open U containing x and a bounded global complex H of O_X-module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] such that H restricted to U is termwise free of rank d i and the termwise stalk complex H_x is isomorphic to F as a complex. No prescribed derived object or derived comparison is assumed or produced.

proof.text: Choose the termwise isomorphisms given by hfree and bounds a,b. A zero free stalk module has rank zero: otherwise evaluation of the constant zero and one functions at an element of Fin(d i) contradicts nontriviality of the stalk ring. Conjugate every differential by these termwise isomorphisms to construct a complex K whose terms are the standard free stalk modules. The isomorphism identities show that its differentials square to zero and define an isomorphism F ≅ K.

Apply the standard-term affine-local matrix lift to K, its definitional term equalities and the proved rank-support condition. Obtain an affine neighbourhood U of x and a local bounded free complex L, with an isomorphism from K to the stalk of its ordinary direct image.

Construct H by applying ordinary open direct image degreewise to L. Sectionwise computation proves preservation of zero morphisms, so the functor preserves zero objects and H has the same bounds a,b. Prove that the counit of restriction/direct image is an isomorphism: Over.forget U is full in the poset of opens, its adjunction unit is invertible, and pushforwardNatIso makes the corresponding counit invertible. Compose this restriction isomorphism termwise with the free-term isomorphisms of L. Finally compose F ≅ K with the stalk-complex isomorphism obtained from the local lift.

mathlib_searches.results: Two searches, eight hits each. Ordinary stalk restriction isomorphisms, Tilde.stalkIso, scheme spreading-out, and stalkwise isomorphism detection; no bounded complex lift or local derived-isomorphism extension.

Mathlib has rankAtStalk, free loci and ordinary stalk isomorphisms, but no complex lifting or local derived comparison. Project finite-free stalk lifting modules start with two existing complexes, use Scheme.Modules/pullback, and the homotopy-spreading theorem compares with a single-degree complex. Internal-Hom stalk localization requires a Noetherian scheme and coherent degree-zero source, so does not apply here.

theorem exists_boundedFree_stalk_complex_lift
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (x : X) (d : ℤ → ℕ)
    (F : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.stalk x)) ℤ)
    (hbounded : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i → IsZero (F.X i))
    (hfree : ∀ i : ℤ, Nonempty (F.X i ≅ ModuleCat.of (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      (ULift.{0} (Fin (d i) → X.presheaf.stalk x)))) :
    ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ IsAffineOpen U ∧
      ∃ H : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ,
        (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i → IsZero (H.X i)) ∧
        (∀ i : ℤ, Nonempty
          ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).obj
            (H.X i) ≅ SheafOfModules.free
              (R := (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U) (ULift.{u} (Fin (d i))))) ∧
        Nonempty (F ≅
          (((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj H))
